headings.usage: Use 'font-outfit' for all H1-H4. text-3xl to text-4xl max for page titles. MUST use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Use for all data tables, inputs, labels, and generic text. Small, dense, highly legible (text-sm is default for data).

colors.strategy: Operations-focused, monochrome structural base with highly visible signal colors for status. No gradients. No marketing fluff.
colors.background: bg-zinc-50 or bg-[#F4F4F5] (Soft off-white for depth)
colors.surface: bg-white (Pure white for all cards, tables, and command panels)

status.warning: text-amber-600 bg-amber-50 (Queued, Waiting for Gap, Paused)

visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Rely on 1px borders (border-collapse on grids) rather than heavy shadows. Use shadow-sm ONLY on dropdowns, modals, and floating action bars.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. Use rounded-md (6px or 8px max). Do not use pill-shaped containers for data widgets.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for operations dashboard to avoid refraction of data. Use solid white backgrounds with strict borders instead.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense. p-4 or p-6 for widget internals. gap-4 or gap-6 for grids.
grids_and_layouts.page_structure: Left Sidebar (collapsible for vertical scaling) + Top Header (Date range, Global Filters, Export) + Main Content Area.

dashboard_zones.top_third: 3-4 primary KPI cards (Sent today, In Queue, Error Rate, Active Inboxes).
dashboard_zones.middle_third: Active Campaigns list vs Server Health / Sending Velocity chart.
dashboard_zones.bottom_third: Live Activity Feed (Real-time logs of 'Sent to X' or 'Waiting 14m for next send').

navigation.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn Sidebar or standard left-nav. Sections: Dashboard, Inboxes (OAuth), Campaigns, Templates, History. Sticky header with breadcrumbs and workspace switcher.

tables.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn Table. Dense padding (py-2 px-3). Include inline row actions on hover. Status columns MUST use badge dots (e.g., small colored circle + text).

scheduler_widget.instructions_to_main_agent: For the 'random gap' feature: Use two distinct input fields for 'Min Gap (mins)' and 'Max Gap (mins)' side-by-side, joined by a dash. Add a subtle helper text: 'System will randomize delay between these values to ensure compliance.'

forms.instructions_to_main_agent: Use React Hook Form + Zod + Shadcn Form primitives. Keep inputs standard, clear borders. No native HTML <input>.

toasts.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Sonner for all success/failure notifications. Position bottom-right.

motion.strategy: Minimalist and functional. No bouncy animations.
motion.interactions: Hover states on table rows (bg-zinc-50/50). Focus states must have higher contrast (ring-2 ring-zinc-900).
motion.loaders: Skeleton loaders for data tables. Real-time pulse indicator (animate-pulse) on the 'Active Sending' status dot.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio. Text inside status badges must be readable.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, row actions) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all inputs and buttons.

icons.usage: Use Phosphor icons with weight='regular' or 'bold' for dense data apps. They look more professional than default icons.

media.empty_states: Use simple abstract geometric shapes or Phosphor icons, not childish illustrations.

login_background.description: Clean, soft white circular abstract background. Use for Auth/Login page background.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You are building a high-trust Operations Dashboard, not a consumer app. Prioritize data density, clarity, and precision.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays. Use bg-white with a bottom border.
Do not use transition: all. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='connect-inbox-button').
Use standard HTML layouts with Tailwind (grid, flex), but ALWAYS use Shadcn for complex interactives (Dropdowns, Dialogs, Selects, Tables).
Do not use generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Avoid gratuitous gradients and soft muddy shadows. Stick to crisp 1px borders and neutral tones with stark signal colors.
Inboxes connection UI must feel secure: use lock icons, green 'connected' indicators, and clear 'OAuth Google' buttons.
For the gap/delay visualization, show a mini timeline or queue list highlighting the 'Next send in X mins' to build trust that the system is respecting the limits.
